days.title: Towns and Ports of the Estuary
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Mundaca
stops.detail: The main population centers are the municipalities of Bermeo, Guernica y Luno and Mundaca.

stops.name: puerto de Bermeo
stops.detail: The port of Bermeo is an important fishing port, one of the most relevant on the northern coast of the peninsula, and maintains some merchant activity after its expansion, but the proximity of the port of Bilbao makes it very limited.

stops.name: Guernica
stops.detail: From Guernica to its mouth in the Cantabrian Sea, the Oca forms an estuary with wide sandy areas.

days.title: History and Bird Watching
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: cueva de Santimamiñe
stops.detail: Prehistoric sites, such as the Santimamiñe cave, are witnesses of human presence since prehistoric times, which is confirmed by the necropolis of Forua, where continuous burials are found from the Roman occupation until the 19th century.

stops.name: Elanchove
stops.detail: This area is covered by the BI-3238 and other small roads such as the BI-3234, which runs along the entire coast of the estuary to Elanchove.
